reason: We do library storytime, parks and the zoo, and those are free. I'd use the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay $13 a kid when I'm just chasing my kid around and not drinking the coffee.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee. Paying $13 for that when the park is free makes no sense to me.
would_change_my_mind: A rainy-day or heat-wave backup with a much lower price, around $6 to $8 a kid, or a free-entry deal tied to a church or hospital group.
